# OpenBoa

> Every limit has a shelf life.

Nothing is permanently out of reach. OpenBoa exists to break what stands between imagination and reality.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://www.openboa.ai/
- Approach (How walls give way): https://www.openboa.ai/approach
- Vision (Nothing is permanently out of reach): https://www.openboa.ai/vision

## Canonical links

- Website: https://www.openboa.ai/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/openboa-ai
- X: https://x.com/openboa_ai

## Vision & Approach summary

Most ceilings survive out of habit rather than natural law. OpenBoa builds environments that collapse coordination drag, operate continuously under clear human authority, separate human purpose from repetitive toil, and prove boundaries by crossing them in the open.
